messages:
elaine: thinking out loud — proposal to prefer an "index-first" warmup path for safetensors shards. read the index/manifest, schedule granular downloads, and only materialize tensors when needed. avoids a big mmap/packed hotstart spike.

elaine: sketch: WeightSource.open(path, mode="index-first") returns an IndexHandle + async download plan. consumers can query slices and trigger fetches.

tomas: +1 on reducing mmap spikes. important to keep a fast fallback when index missing. sometimes we only have legacy .safetensors without index.

mohit: how expensive is an index read? is it one small read per shard or a network roundtrip per tensor? we need cost bounds.

elaine: usually one small read per shard (header + metadata). we can batch index reads in one ranged request. network overhead << full shard.

kat: what about compatibility with existing ShardManager? we shouldn't force all callers to know about IndexHandle. keep a thin adapter.

elaine: agreed. plan: introduce IndexAwareWeightSource that implements WeightSource API but does index-first internally. ShardManager keeps same contract. callers opt-in via config.

jess: concern: ordering guarantees. some callers currently assume immediate mmap -> pointer stable. index-first implies lazy materialization; we must define pinned vs transient handles.

elaine: propose two levels: .pin() (materialize into local cache or mmap) and .view() (stream-backed, ephemeral). default view for low-latency cold-start, explicit pin for hot layers.

sylvie: nice. fallback semantics? if download plan fails mid-fetch, what do we serve? stream from fallback model shard (packfile or smaller quantized variant)?

mohit: implement policy layer: route by priority (pinned layers > partial stream > fallback variant). add metrics so runtime can tune thresholds.

tomas: also add a small manifest checksum in index to detect mismatches. avoids silent corruption when shards are replaced.

elaine: agree. index entry: {version, checksum, layout, tensor-locations}. simple and small.

infra-bot: deploy reminder: please add feature flag "index_first_warmup" and rollout to staging only.

kat: operator UX: we need tooling to visualize what shards are partially fetched and eviction candidates. can we reuse existing cache dashboard?

elaine: yes, extend cache dashboard with per-tensor fetch progress + bytes-per-second. add alert when streaming fallback rate > 20% of requests.

jess: edgecases: streaming view + kv-cache. when KV cache is reused across requests, we must ensure lazy-load race doesn't duplicate work. use singleflight per tensor id.

elaine: noted — singleflight + inflight promises. also add adaptive prefetch: if a tensor is requested N times within window, auto-pin. threshold tunable by workload.

sylvie: tests? fuzzing load failures and partial content. also measure cold-start P99 for mix of prompt lengths.

elaine: next steps: (1) PR for Index schema + proto, (2) IndexAwareWeightSource impl behind flag, (3) ShardManager adapter + singleflight, (4) dashboard metrics + alerts. I'll open issues and assign.

kat: thanks, this feels like a good middle ground — incremental opt-in and clear operator controls.

elaine: thanks all. I'll paste the RFC sketch in the thread and link PR after I open it. :thumbsup:
